# Security policy

The threat model, the accepted trade-offs and what is explicitly out of scope
live in **[docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md)**.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue.

- Preferred: [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/aliosmanmho/PeerPages/security/advisories/new)
- Alternative: open a normal issue saying only "security report, please
  contact me", with no details, and wait to be contacted.

Expect a first response within **7 days**. This is a side project maintained
by one person; there is no paid bounty, and fixes ship when they are ready.
